name: IskraCore Training Manager
author: Amir Balic

sections.description:
IskraCore Training Manager lets clubs and coaches publish training sessions directly from their WordPress dashboard. Add a title, description, date, start/end time, coach, location and sport category. Optionally repeat a training each week until a chosen date.

Display a calendar with month, week and list views. Visitors can filter by sport, see details and show or hide cancelled sessions. A single weekly occurrence can be cancelled or have its time, coach or location changed without affecting the rest of the series.

The plugin runs on your WordPress installation. Training data is stored in your WordPress database; the Free plugin does not require an account or communicate training data to an external IskraCore service.

The free calendar and all of its scheduling features work without a license. Optional PRO capabilities (member management, registrations, attendance, reporting, and email notifications) are supplied by a separately distributed premium add-on. The Free plugin only displays information about those options and never locks its own features.

Source Code

Human-readable PHP, JavaScript and CSS files are included in this plugin. No compilation, bundling or minification step is required to reproduce the distributed assets. No external JavaScript or CSS libraries are bundled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install through the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate IskraCore Training Manager.
  3. Go to Training Manager > All Trainings > Add New Training.
  4. Enter the training details and publish.
  5. Add the [iskracore_training_calendar] shortcode to a page.
sections.faq:
Does the calendar work without any paid add-on?

Yes. Training creation, recurring sessions, calendar views, filters and date exceptions are included in this plugin.

How do I display the calendar?

Add [iskracore_training_calendar] to a page or post. Use [iskracore_training_calendar view="week"] for a weekly default view, or view="list" for the list view. Use wide="no" to keep the calendar within the theme content width.

Can I cancel one training in a weekly series?

Yes. Edit the training and use the Individual dates section to cancel one occurrence, then update the training. You can restore it later without changing the rest of the series.

Where is information stored?

Training schedules are stored in your site’s WordPress posts and metadata. The public calendar retrieves published, non-password-protected sessions via a read-only REST endpoint on the same site. Password-protected, private and draft training details are not included in the calendar response. No external account is required.

Does deactivation erase training data?

No. Deactivating the plugin does not remove posts or training metadata.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Add a direct Buy PRO link to Freemius checkout on the optional premium preview screens.
  • Display six authentic screenshots of the separate PRO add-on on the Explore PRO page.
  • Display a relevant PRO screenshot on each informational feature preview page.
  • Keep all scheduling tools free; no premium feature implementations are bundled.

1.0.4

  • Add a dedicated overview of optional premium capabilities inside Training Manager.
  • Show contextual preview pages for members, registrations, attendance, reporting and notifications when PRO is not active.
  • Keep all free features fully functional and exclude premium feature code from the Free plugin.
  • Defer navigation to the actual PRO modules when the licensed add-on is active.

1.0.3

  • Display a styled single-training details page with date, time, sport, coach, location and full description.
  • Link calendar sessions to their specific dates, including weekly schedule overrides and cancellation notices.
  • Render individual training pages through a dedicated template, eliminating duplicate titles and theme author metadata.
  • Preserve site header and footer for classic and block themes.

1.0.2

  • Exclude password-protected trainings from the public calendar REST endpoint.
  • Add a second access guard before returning event content to public visitors.

1.0.1

  • Make training editor labels and recurring-series controls translatable.
  • Preserve published training title and description when an invalid schedule is submitted.
  • Reject invalid exception changes without partially saving schedule metadata.
  • Finalize WordPress.org documentation and release metadata.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release with monthly, weekly and list calendars.
  • Weekly training series, sport filters, and per-date cancellation or updates.
  • Standalone Free plugin; no external service required.

0.5.4

  • Fix Plugin Check readme header and clarify translation loading.
  • Sanitize session exception form fields after the verified editor nonce.

0.5.2

  • Prepared standalone Free package and updated public documentation.
  • Prevented invalid new training schedules from being published.
  • Removed development and add-on status messaging from the Free dashboard.

0.5.1

  • Added weekly date cancellations, overrides and public sport filters.
  • Improved calendar layout for responsive themes.
